title: One suggestion a model read made from an item
description: An item's latest suggestion, with what a person needs to judge it before acting on it: the scanner's findings first, then the sentence, then its source. The sentence is a model's answer over outsider text, so the suggestion takes the item's zone. A reader that copies this file keeps its bytes and its $id.

item_key.description: The item the suggestion was read from.

zone.description: Who wrote the source: outside or owner.

findings.description: Each finding the scanner made in the source and in the sentence.

prompt_version.description: The model read prompt's version that wrote the sentence.

lens.description: The lens the model read answered under, with its version.
